capabilities.name: Let an agent see your accounts and start payments through your bank
capabilities.question: Can an AI agent read your bank accounts and start payments through regulated open banking APIs?

US.note: The CFPB finalised its Section 1033 data rights rule, but a court stayed its compliance dates in October 2025 and the CFPB is reworking it, so there is no regulated access yet. Aggregators like Plaid connect apps to banks outside a mandated regime.

evidence.title: Personal financial data rights
Section 1033
Plaid: Enabling all companies to build fintech solutions

GB.note: The CMA9 open banking mandate gives licensed apps account data and payment initiation, and platforms such as TrueLayer and Plaid connect apps to it. The UK Payments Initiative launched its commercial Variable Recurring Payments scheme in June 2026, starting with a first wave of lower-risk sectors only.

DE.note: EU PSD2, applied in Germany through the ZAG, makes banks give licensed account information and payment initiation providers API access. BaFin licenses these providers, and platforms such as Tink and TrueLayer serve German banks. There is no standard for recurring variable payments yet.

BR.note: Open Finance Brasil, run by the Banco Central, is mandatory for large institutions and lets licensed payment initiators (ITPs) start Pix, Pix Automático and no-redirect (JSR) payments, and IN BCB 746 removes the fixed R$500 cap on JSR payments from 1 October 2026. Connectors such as Belvo and Pluggy plug apps into it.

MX.note: Article 76 of the 2018 Fintech Law mandates open APIs, but only open-data (and credit bureau) rules exist; the CNBV and Banxico have still not issued the rules for account and transaction data, so there is no regulated access yet. Aggregators like Belvo connect apps to banks outside a mandated regime.

CL.note: Ley Fintec 21.521 created the CMF Sistema de Finanzas Abiertas (NCG 514, technical standards in NCG 569 of June 2026), but the CMF pushed its start from July 2026 to July 2027, so it is not live yet. Until then, firms like Fintoc connect bank accounts and start transfers outside a regulated regime.

CO.note: A voluntary open finance scheme (Decree 1297 of 2022, Superfinanciera Circular 004 of 2024) is in place, and Decree 368 of April 2026 makes it mandatory, but the SFC has not yet set the mandatory rules and timeline.

IN.note: The RBI Account Aggregator framework, with Sahamati as its industry body, lets apps read your accounts with consent (over 500 million consents by September 2026). NPCI's UPI lets third-party apps start payments for you, and Setu offers APIs for both.

capabilities.name: Ask your bank's assistant to send money or pay bills
capabilities.question: Can a bank's own AI assistant send money or pay bills for you by chat or voice?

US.note: Bank of America's Erica can send and request money with Zelle and schedule bill payments inside the mobile app.

evidence.title: Erica, your virtual financial assistant

GB.note: Zopa's AI assistant, Ask, sends money, requests payments and pays invoices from a photo, by voice or chat, for its Biscuit current account customers (launched September 2026). Starling Assistant (March 2026) sets up savings transfers and organises bill payments for personal customers who opt in. Revolut's AIR freezes cards and buys eSIMs, and NatWest Cora handles questions and fraud claims. Lloyds said its agentic assistant would carry out payment requests, but in October 2026 we found no sign it had reached all customers, and we found no Monzo assistant that moves money.

evidence.title: Zopa unveils UK's most helpful banking AI

Revolut enters new era of money intelligence with launch of AI assistant
Being a trusted partner for tomorrow's banking through technology

DE.note: Commerzbank's Ava can block cards, check balances and order products, but we found no sign it makes transfers, Sparkasse chat channels say they do not accept transfer orders, and bunq describes its Finn assistant (December 2025 upgrade) as support and information only. In October 2026 N26's press room listed no AI assistant, ING's virtual assistant in its app only answers questions, and searches found nothing for Deutsche Bank beyond an old Siri transfer feature. Searches for DKB's AI support assistant showed only customer service, with no sign of transfers. We kept the flag because no bank page rules out a launch we missed.

BR.note: Nubank's AI sends Pix from a text, photo or voice message in the app and on WhatsApp (WhatsApp capped at R$800 per transfer). Bradesco's BIA makes Pix transfers and pays bills by voice or text in its app and by text on WhatsApp, and Itaú's ia.i also does transactions by chat.

MX.note: BBVA México's Blue assistant makes transfers, pays credit cards and sets up cardless withdrawals from a typed or spoken command, with a password check before each one.

evidence.title: Blue es el asistente virtual de la app BBVA
Cuatro funcionalidades de Blue para facilitar la vida de los clientes

CL.note: Itaú Chile launched voice and text transfers to third parties in its app in June 2026, where an AI agent fills in the transfer and the user confirms with Itaú Pass. We count it as limited because only news reports describe it and no Itaú page confirms that all customers have it. In October 2026 we found no similar feature at BancoEstado, Banco de Chile, BCI or Santander Chile.

evidence.title: Itaú Chile lanza Transferencias por Voz y da un paso hacia la banca conversacional
Itaú lanza funcionalidad para hacer transferencias usando la voz en su app

CO.note: Davivienda's DaviPlata wallet let users who signed up with a QR code move money by voice or AI chat in a first phase from June 2024, but we could not confirm it is open to all users today. The payments app Tpaga (not a bank) launched a WhatsApp AI agent in July 2026 that pays utility bills and sends Bre-B transfers. Bancolombia's Tabot only answers questions, and we found no assistant that moves money at Nequi.

evidence.title: En DaviPlata ahora podrá manejar su dinero con la voz

Tabot asistente virtual

IN.note: News reports say Indian Bank's AI-TARA voice assistant (unveiled September 2026) does fund transfers and IMPS in 10 languages, but the bank's own investor deck only calls it a voice AI relationship manager and does not say all customers have it. NPCI's Hello! UPI voice payments roll out in phases, and Axis Bank's new branch kiosk (September 2026) has an AI assistant that fills in forms for services like utility bill payments. SBI's YONO Ji assistant answers questions for YONO Business users, and we found no assistant that moves money at HDFC or ICICI.

repos.name: Plaid Python library
repos.role: Official Python client for Plaid, so an agent written in Python can read linked bank accounts and transactions.

repos.name: Pluggy Node SDK
repos.role: Official Node.js client for Pluggy, a Brazilian aggregator that connects to banks through Open Finance Brasil to read accounts and start Pix payments.

repos.name: Fintoc Python library
repos.role: Official Python client for Fintoc, a Chilean service that reads bank account movements and starts bank transfer payments.

repos.name: Open Bank Project API
repos.role: Open-source API server a bank runs to give apps and agents standard open banking access to accounts, transactions and payments (PSD2, UK and Berlin Group styles).

repos.name: UK Open Banking Read/Write API specs
repos.role: The official UK open banking standard that licensed apps use to read account data and start payments, including variable recurring payments, at UK banks.

repos.role: Open-source core banking system with a full API for accounts, loans, savings and transfers, so a bank or microfinance lender can let its own assistant move money.
